decisions.title: Header-only SIMD Backends
decisions.rationale: Allows aggressive inlining by the compiler and simplifies multi-arch build dispatching via headers.

decisions.title: Static Work Distribution
decisions.rationale: Reduces mutex contention in search loops; threads work on independent ranges.

decisions.title: Custom Crypto Implementation
decisions.rationale: External libraries lack the specific SIMD optimizations needed for high-speed secp256k1 search.

decisions.title: Static-Performance Dispatch
decisions.rationale: Eliminates branch overhead in hot loops by selecting optimal SIMD kernels at runtime using function pointers.

decisions.title: Zero-Cost Cuckoo Hashing
decisions.rationale: Reuses existing HASH160 bits for Cuckoo fingerprints and indices, avoiding redundant hashing cycles.

decisions.title: ARMv8 Crypto Extension Integration
decisions.rationale: Directly utilizes specialized hardware instructions (vsha256hq_u32) for SHA256, providing superior throughput compared to pure SIMD (NEON).

decisions.title: Universal ARM64 Detection (Linux/macOS)
decisions.rationale: Implements platform-specific detection (getauxval for Linux, sysctlbyname for macOS) to ensure optimal kernel selection on both cloud servers and workstations.
